name: dsh-context-governor
description: Keeps the Harness context ceiling honest for local models: asks the model endpoint for the maximum context it actually reports (Strata /health max_context, OpenAI-compatible /v1/models, llama.cpp /props, vLLM /server_info, Ollama /api/show), fixes the routed provider model's contextWindow in the profile patch, and drives automatic compaction at a ratio you choose (default: compact once the session reaches 0.8 of the window). Host side plus a bilingual Settings → Context section; zero external dependencies.
author: ecbob

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check scripts/selftest.mjs
